summary: Replaced the replay-completion account with a successor citing all three receipts. Receipt ebb3bb9fa26547f790129eea909d1d5a adds the measured availability consequence: a three-voter group at MaxAppendEntries 16 with A's staged commit index 3000 above an absent snapshot (event 9, 188 batches); with the replay on, NewRaft did not return within 8000ms (event 10, replay frames in the stack), the group committed while two members were live, and after one further stop the next command failed with 'leadership lost while committing log' (witness event 11, comparison violated); with the replay off the member returned in 0ms and the surviving pair committed after the same stop (event 14, control holds). The account now covers mechanism, block, measured bound (94 versus 188 batches at MaxAppendEntries 16, so 128 x MaxAppendEntries) and the lost fault-tolerance margin, with joint_history across the three executions, five knowledge uses, six counterevidence items (deliberate second stop, surviving leader's own step-down error text, default-cadence reachability still unmeasured, bracketed bound, abandoned goroutine) and four limitations. This turn submitted only the citation; the default-configuration reachability probe remains the next construction step if time allows.
